public class Main {

        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] a = new int[5];
        int n, i, mx, mn, k;
        n = sc.nextInt();
        mx = 2000;
        mn = 2200;
        i = 0;
        do {
            if (i >= n) break;
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
            if (a[i] > mx) mx = a[i];
            if (a[i] < mn) mn = a[i];
            ++i;
        } while (i < n);
        k = (mx - mn) / 2;
        System.out.println(mx - k);
    }
}
